# Game Mechanics Vault

> Interactive 4-Bucket Game Design & Engine Implementation Knowledge Graph (Theory, Engine/Code, Game Juice, Anti-Patterns) with linked_systems across 28 domains.

## Core Entry Points
- [Vault Home](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/): Main entry page and domain directory
- [Linked Systems Graph](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/linked_systems_graph): Master cross-system dependency network
- [Full Plain-Text Context](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/llms-full.txt): Single-file context dump for LLM ingestion

## 28 Game Design Domains
- [Exploration](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/01_Exploration): Curiosity-driven non-linear world traversal, vista framing, hidden path rewards, and intrinsic discovery loops.
- [Player Guidance](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/02_Player_Guidance): Communicating spatial affordances, leading lines, contrast ratios, and objective salience without patronizing hand-holding.
- [Diegetic Guidance](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/03_Diegetic_Guidance): In-world spatial guidance using wind currents, volumetric god rays, pulsing emissives, NPC gaze, and spatialized audio cues.
- [Landmark Guidance](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/04_Landmark_Guidance): Hierarchical macro/meso/micro silhouettes and elevated sightline anchors that prevent player disorientation in open worlds.
- [Environmental Storytelling](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/05_Environmental_Storytelling): Prop placement, architectural decay, spatial vignettes, and visual juxtaposition conveying narrative lore with zero dialogue.
- [Navigation](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/06_Navigation): Mental map formation, loop-back shortcuts, elevation gradients, and readable choke-points that replace GPS minimaps.
- [Combat](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/07_Combat): Risk-reward spacing, frame-accurate hitboxes, telegraphing windows, stagger states, and responsive player-enemy exchanges.
- [Stealth](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/08_Stealth): Granular suspicion meters, light/shadow occlusion, sound propagation radii, and predator-prey recovery loops.
- [Traversal](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/09_Traversal): Momentum preservation, coyote time, jump buffering, ledge snap, grappling hooks, and vertical obstacle rhythm.
- [Progression](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/10_Progression): Horizontal ability gating, vertical stat curves, build synergies, and meaningful mastery milestones.
- [Quest Design](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/11_Quest_Design): Non-linear state machines, multi-solution objective graphs, diegetic journals, and anti-backtracking world topology.
- [Puzzle Design](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/12_Puzzle_Design): Aha-moment epistemic shifts, rule-discovery onboarding without text walls, and clean lock-and-key state constraints.
- [Enemy AI](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/13_Enemy_AI): Behavior trees, utility scoring, attack-token coordinators, flanking roles, and readable bark telegraphs.
- [Boss Design](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/14_Boss_Design): Multi-phase escalation, arena geometry shifts, punish windows, and rhythm-testing mechanics checks.
- [Reward Systems](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/15_Reward_Systems): Intrinsic mastery rewards vs. extrinsic variable-ratio loot drops, anticipation pacing, and dopamine curve hygiene.
- [Tutorial & Onboarding](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/16_Tutorial_Onboarding): Safe isolated sandbox rooms, teaching through level constraints, and immediate action-feedback loops before UI prompts.
- [Difficulty Design](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/17_Difficulty_Design): Flow-channel calibration, rubber-banding, opt-in risk modifiers, and assistive accessibility sliders.
- [Economy](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/18_Economy): Currency faucets vs. sinks, inflation containment, scarcity friction, and meaningful trade-off curves.
- [Crafting](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/19_Crafting): Inventory-pressure recipes, meaningful material sinks, experimentation discovery, and crafting-to-combat loops.
- [Multiplayer](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/20_Multiplayer): Client-side prediction, lag compensation, rollback netcode, server authority, and cooperative verb synergies.
- [Social Systems](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/21_Social_Systems): Asynchronous bloodstains/messages, non-toxic ping wheels, shared world state, and social proof triggers.
- [Level Design](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/22_Level_Design): Kishotenketsu 4-beat pacing, verticality loops, gating valves, sightline triangles, and encounter sightlines.
- [World Building](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/23_World_Building): Cohesive faction ecology, systemic weather rules, architectural logic, and believable macro-world simulation.
- [Camera & Player Perspective](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/24_Camera_Perspective): Spring-arm lag, dynamic FOV sprints, target-lock framing, occlusion fade shaders, and trauma-driven shake.
- [Player Agency](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/25_Player_Agency): Systemic verb combinations, emergent chemistry engines, meaningful trade-offs, and non-scripted problem solving.
- [Discovery](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/26_Discovery): Rule-bending epiphanies, tactile secret wall cues, environmental anomalies, and curiosity payoffs.
- [Risk & Reward](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/27_Risk_Reward): Push-your-luck extraction mechanics, stamina-vs-greed windows, and high-stakes recovery stakes.
- [Retention & Live Systems](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/gamedev-mechanics-vault/categories/28_Retention_Live_Systems): Ethical long-term mastery loops, seasonal modifiers, anti-burnout pacing, and avoiding manipulative dark patterns.
